description: Declared mutants of the physics_3d Module (docs/architecture/target/v2/physics-3d-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 6; Design Invariants P3-1 to P3-6 drafted in section 8 for docs/architecture/target/v2/physics-3d.zh-Hant.md; ids p3-). A mutant is killed only when the named test case fails with the expected message.

mutants.what: a BoxSet ray keeps the higher index when two boxes tie on t. Only it catches the tie rule of the ray query (the normal of the lower index's face)
mutants.cases: queries: a ray reaching two boxes*

mutants.what: the ray traversal skips a node whose entry equals the best t. Only it catches a pruned subtree that holds a tied lower index
the deepest BoxSet contact keeps the higher index when two boxes tie on distance
a BoxSet shape cast keeps the higher index when two boxes tie on time. Only the randomized equivalence catches it (the fixed cases tie on equal witnesses)
the query box that picks BoxSet candidates for contacts and casts is shrunk instead of grown by a margin: boxes the linear scan reports are missed
with stopAtPenetration false, a tangential motion (Dot(motion, normal1) == 0) from an overlap counts as a hit. Only it catches the boundary of the separation test
mutants.cases: queries: a cast that starts overlapping*

mutants.what: Collider's HashValue leaves out the BoxSet digest: two BoxSets of the same count with different boxes hash equal while == says they differ (CCR-13)
the World queries ignore a Transform scale other than (1, 1, 1) instead of returning UnsupportedScale
CastMove adds the skin distance instead of pulling back by it: the shape ends inside the skin (or past the contact). Only it catches the sign of avian's pull_back
merging two nearly parallel planes keeps the less blocking one: part of the velocity still points into the more blocking plane
mutants.find: if (Math::Dot(n, v) < Math::Dot(ToVec3d(existing), v)) existing = normal;
mutants.replace: if (Math::Dot(n, v) > Math::Dot(ToVec3d(existing), v)) existing = normal;
